content.text:
Two wake-ups is totally normal at 19 months but it can shift — the most effective thing to try is a consistent wind-down routine (bath, book, same song, lights out) and then responding to wake-ups with calm, brief check-ins rather than feeding or rocking back to sleep, so Remy learns to resettle independently.
